description: This is a Java interface defining a service for handling order product downloads within the sales manager application. It extends a generic entity service and includes a method to retrieve downloads by order ID.

classes.name: OrderProductDownloadService
classes.description: A Java interface that provides methods for managing order product downloads, particularly retrieving downloads associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getByOrderId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OrderProductDownload objects associated with the specified order ID.
